pātarāsa.p: [ pāto + āsa ] (ti) Google Translate (1) Food to be eaten in the morning before noon. Breakfast. (2) Breakfast place.

R:
pātarāsa：ပါတရာသ （ပ） （ပါတရ်+အာသ）

ပါတရာသံ ကတွာ၊ နံနက်စာစားခြင်းကို ပြု၍။ ပါတရာသကာလေ၊ နံနက်စာစားသောအခါ၌။သာယမာသ

patarati.p: [Pa+tara+a+ti.] (kri) Google Translate (1) (a) transit (b) especially transit (c) transcendence (2) transcendence (3) exertion Of

H: patarati：[pa-tarati＜tṛ] 通過（go through），渡過（cross over）； 溢出（overflow，boil over （of water））．aor．patari； caus．patāreti．
S: patarati：[pa-tarati＜tṛ] 通過す，渡る； こぼれる．aor．patari； caus．patāreti．
B:
patarati： patarati（kri）
ပတရတိ（ကြိ）
[pa+tara+a+ti．]
[ပ+တရ+အ+တိ။]
P: Patarati，[pa+tarati] 1．to go through or forth，to run out，to cross over D．I，248； J．III，91 （aor．patari）．-- 2．to overflow，boil over （of water） Miln．260．-- Caus．patāreti （q．v．）．（Page 405）
R:
patarati：ပ-တရတိ （ပ√တရ်）

DOP: patarati pr. 3 sg. [ S. pratarati], crosses; crosses by swimming; strives; overcomes; D I 248, 16 (sukkhataraṃ maññe ~anti, Ee so; Ce sukkhataraṇaṃ; Be, Se taranti; Sv 404, 20 foll.: marīcikāya vañcitvā kākapeyyā nadī ti saññāya tarissāmā ti hatthehi ca pādehi ca vāyamānā); A IV 11, 12 (ekacco puggalo ummujjitvā ~ati … ekacco puggalo ummujjitvā patigādhappatto hoti; Mp IV 5, 22 : ~atī ti gantabbadisābhimukho tarati nāma) ≠ Kv 589, 21 ; Th 1104 (kadā nu Gaṅgaṃ … asajjamāno ~eyyam iddhiyā); Nidd II [ Be ] 104, 13 (tarassu uttarassu ~assu, Be, Ce, Se so; Ee omits ); Mil 260, 1 ([udakaṃ] uttarati ~ati); — part.pr. pataranta, mfn. , Pp-a 253, 12 ; — aor. 3 sg. patari, Nidd I 247, 20 (atari uttari ~i, Be, Ce so; Ee, Se pattari); Pp-a 252, 33 ( Be, Ce, Se so; Ee ~ati); 2 sg. patari, Ja III 91, 22* (kathaṃ samuddaṃ ~i kathaṃ ~i Kebukaṃ, Ee so, perhaps wr; Be, Ce, Se atari); 3 pl. patariṃsu, Nidd II [ Be ] 54, 29 ( Ee 159, 23 ); — absol. pataritvā, Mp IV 5, 23 ; Pp-a 252, 19 ; — pp patarita , mfn. , who has swum, made an effort; Pp-a 253, 11 (~-puriso viya kilesatanutāya pataranto sakadāgāmī); — caus. pr. 3 sg. patāreti , ~ayati , 1. sends or guides across; persuades to; A II 201, 26 (nāvaṃ katvā … nadiṃ ~eyya); Ja V 66, 14* (atitthe nappatāreyya, Be, Ce, Se so; Ee wr nappātareyya); Vism 208, 18 (satthavāho satthe … nirudakakantāraṃ tāreti uttāreti nittāreti ~eti); Th-a II 193, 7 (na sakkā imaṃ kāmesu ~etun ti); — 2. strives; works for; A III 432, 12 (uttariṃ ca ~eti; Mp III 413, 3 : sampati ca uttariṃ ca viriyaṃ karot’ eva); — aor. 3 sg. ( a ) patāresi, M I 225, 9 (gopālako … pārimaṃ tīraṃ atitthen’ eva gāvo ~esi; Ps II 265, 23 : ~esī ti tāretuṃ ārabhi); ( b ) patārayi, Ja III 210, 15* (tassūparodhaṃ parisaṅkamāno ~ayī mūlavadhāya dhīro; 210, 18´ : patarati vāyamati); VI 326, 7´ ; ( c ) patārayittha, Ja VI 326, 2* (~ayittha maraṇāya mayhaṃ); 2 sg. patārayi, Ja V 117, 7* (mā tāta issaro ’mhī ti anatthāya ~ayi; 119, 17´ : mā mahājanaṃ kāyaduccaritādi-anatthāya ~ayi mā otārayi); 1 sg. patārayiṃ, Ja VI 307, 12* (307, 15´ : ~ayin ti cittaṃ pavattesiṃ); — pp patārita, mfn. , persuaded; Vv-a 336, 8 (kenaci anatthakāmena ~itā, Ce, Ee so; Be, Se palobhitā); — see also duppatara.

S: patāreti：[patarati＜tṛ の caus．] 渡す，努める．aor．patārayi．
